summary: Compose actual cell publications with source-admitted ordered assembly using checked serialized integer rows; verify nonzero composition with resource-bounded kernel checks.

examined.reason: Derive ordered table representation, active-cell store confinement and metadata preservation; compose actual cell execution families with admitted assembly. Explain finite witness checker soundness and remaining grid/solver obligations; maintain summaries and exact links.
Add the cell-to-assembly operator connection and correct stale remaining assembly obligations without claiming arbitrary grid schedules or full solver correspondence.
Equations, TorchLean reference code, emitted kernels, host solver and README are unchanged.

Review verifies actual event provenance, padding exclusion, disjoint cell planes, common input memory and CTA identities, ordered integer reconstruction, preservation of metadata and byte-source soundness. Neither a desired intermediate tensor nor an assembled result is an execution premise. Full PTX admission and CUDA transport are not claimed.

results.method: Sequential resource-limited Lean checks of all 17 new modules; exact full declaration-dependency audit; pin/source guards; saved emitted-code bindings; 27 Poisson Python tests; receipt hash verification; Stratic validation and manual proof/contract review.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and 16 dependency pins. Heavy checks under a hard 6 GiB cgroup cap, no swap, 150 percent CPU quota. No GPU rerun or paid model calls.
results.evidence: 4547 exact dependency reports, only standard Lean axioms; 531 guarded Lean sources. All new modules freshly checked through sequential limited runs: the first eight and the next five passed unchanged; the revised padding checker and new whole-word checker passed separately; the final nonzero witness and composition regression passed, followed by the complete dependency audit. Initial resource-limit failures were resolved with sound finite-checker changes; no failing check is accepted. The full registered build and unchanged legacy interpreter checks were not rerun. Existing targeted build/binding commands pass against 30 saved layouts (720 contraction and 630 shared-store blocks); 27 Python tests pass. All 528 receipt source hashes match. CSR reconstruction preserves rounded order; metadata preservation follows from actual active-lane store addresses; cell publication supplies actual assembly inputs. Nonzero synthetic composition produces eight and a forged read is rejected. General cell existence, grid scheduling, imperative array bridge, serialization and remaining solver correspondence are still explicit. Stratic valid, final snapshots identical, README unchanged.
